fieldValues.title: A minutes file can withhold the transcript and keep its evidence
fieldValues.summary: With the transcript's content file removed and its sidecar kept, the slice still validates, packs and passes the document checks; the 53 fragments used as evidence keep their words and the off-the-record fragments never had any.
evidence: repo validate on the tombstoned slice: 0 errors, 1 warning (RFC-017 R12 content unavailable)
runner check: fragments tile lines 1-824; source withheld
fieldValues.body: This is the export proposed decision a089adfd asks for. There is no command for it: the content file was deleted by hand.
